evidence_levels.title: Open national context
evidence_levels.role: Automatable discovery geometry, terrain, planning indexes, environment and risk screening.
evidence_levels.promotion_limit: May screen and derive context; cannot prove title, entitlement, legal access, utility capacity or field conditions.

evidence_levels.title: Municipal planning record
evidence_levels.role: Governing plan documents, legal status, plan provisions, permit history and municipal interpretation.
evidence_levels.promotion_limit: May establish the planning basis when the complete current municipal record is bound; does not prove ownership, boundary monuments or utility capacity.

evidence_levels.title: Authoritative property record
evidence_levels.role: Requested register facts for ownership, mortgages, tax, rights, joint facilities and cadastral acts.
evidence_levels.promotion_limit: Register facts remain distinct from the indicative digital boundary and must not be converted into a surveyed legal boundary.

evidence_levels.title: Field and provider proof
evidence_levels.role: Survey, ground investigation, radon and contamination testing, line marking and capacity responses.
evidence_levels.promotion_limit: Closes only the scope actually investigated or confirmed, with date, method, responsible party and signed deliverable retained.

always_requires_case_checks: the new building is smaller than the building it complements
the placement is within the plot and boundary-distance rules are satisfied
the aggregate area of all permit-exempt complementary buildings is counted
expanded permit requirements or plan provisions do not apply
heritage, total-defence, road, railway, shoreline and protected-area rules are checked
technical notification, start clearance and building regulations are checked separately

sources.name: Markhöjdmodell Nedladdning, API
sources.coverage: Sweden, product availability by STAC item
sources.currentness: Continuously updated national 1 m ground-height model; bind the selected item version and acquisition metadata.

licence.name: CC BY 4.0 or less restrictive HVD terms
licence.note: Capture the product terms returned at acquisition.

limitations: One-metre grid resolution is not a field topographic survey.
Vertical reference and item metadata must be recorded from the delivered asset.

sources.name: Ortofoto Nedladdning, API
sources.coverage: Sweden, varying image year and resolution
sources.currentness: Per-image acquisition date; never use retrieval time as image date.

licence.name: HVD terms subject to access review
licence.note: Access setup and personal-data review may apply.

limitations: Visible conditions may have changed since acquisition.
Imagery is contextual evidence, not a planning or property record.

sources.name: Fastighetsindelning Nedladdning, vektor API
sources.coverage: Sweden
sources.currentness: Weekly pre-produced vector releases; bind collection and item version.

licence.name: HVD terms with Fastighetsregisterlagen access review
licence.note: No fee, but ordering, access setup and legal review are required.

limitations: The digital register-map boundary is explicitly not legally binding.
Three-dimensional property information may be incomplete during the 2026 product transition.

sources.name: Byggnad Nedladdning, vektor API
sources.coverage: Sweden
sources.currentness: Weekly pre-produced vector releases; attributes and completeness vary.

licence.name: HVD terms subject to access review
licence.note: Personal-data review and access setup may apply.

limitations: Building geometry supports context only until municipal records and measured heights are joined.

sources.name: Standard information from the property register
sources.coverage: One identified property, joint property or joint facility per request
sources.currentness: Current when issued; record issue time and requested property designation.

licence.note: Requested official record; retention and personal-data handling must follow the delivery terms.

limitations: The free standard extract is not the full property-register record.
Additional records and cadastral acts may be required for rights and boundary interpretation.

sources.name: Nationella geodataplattformen — Detaljplan
sources.coverage: Participating municipality submissions; older plans may be absent
sources.currentness: Producer-supplied plan version and legal status; verify against municipality.

licence.name: NGP consumer terms
licence.note: Capture the terms and municipal producer for each record.

limitations: Plans begun before 2022-01-01 need not be digitally available.
Records can include plans that have not gained legal force.
The complete municipal plan map, provisions, description and amendments remain controlling evidence.

sources.name: Boverket open plan-provision catalogue
sources.coverage: National plan-provision vocabulary
sources.currentness: Continuously maintained catalogue; bind API version and retrieval date.

licence.name: Open data with attribution
licence.note: Boverket attribution is required.

cannot_prove: which provision applies to a plot
limitations: The catalogue explains provision concepts; it is not the property-specific plan record.

sources.name: Current permit rules for complementary residential buildings
sources.coverage: Sweden under the current PBL profile
sources.currentness: Law 2025:974 effective 2025-12-01; re-check at every assessment.

licence.name: Public legal guidance
licence.note: Cite Boverket and the current PBL provisions.

limitations: H30/H50 is conditional on location, existing buildings, aggregate area, height, placement and special protections.
Municipal building-committee review remains required for the actual case.

sources.name: Municipal plan, building-permit and base-map archive
sources.coverage: One municipality and identified property
sources.currentness: Bind legal-force date, amendment chain, archival issue date and municipal source.

licence.note: Municipality-specific public-record and reuse terms.

limitations: Municipal systems, digitisation and record completeness vary.
A map portal view alone does not close the gate; complete governing documents and legal status are required.

sources.name: Jordarter 1:25 000–1:100 000
sources.coverage: Sweden with scale and detail varying by area
sources.currentness: Product edition and mapping scale must be retained.

licence.name: CC BY 4.0
licence.note: SGU geological data are open data.

limitations: Regional mapping is a screening layer and cannot replace a site investigation.

sources.name: Jorddjupsmodell and observations
sources.coverage: Sweden; model plus unevenly distributed observations
sources.currentness: Bind product edition and distinguish observations from interpolation.

licence.name: CC BY 4.0
licence.note: SGU geological data are open data.

limitations: The national model is explicitly overview-level and interpolated between observations.

sources.name: Brunnar open data
sources.coverage: Reported wells in Sweden, with records submitted since 1976
sources.currentness: Per-record construction and submission data; neighbouring records are not plot measurements.

licence.name: CC BY 4.0
licence.note: Coordinates use SWEREF 99 TM, EPSG:3006.

limitations: Well positions and attributes are reported observations and can have quality limitations.

sources.name: Groundwater models, aquifers and quality open data
sources.coverage: Product-dependent national or regional coverage
sources.currentness: Bind the chosen product, model date and observation period.

licence.name: CC BY 4.0
licence.note: SGU geological data are open data.

cannot_prove: water quality at a proposed well
limitations: Models and nearby observations inform investigation scope but do not replace site testing or permit review.

sources.name: Maps for landslide, erosion, quick clay and ground movement
sources.coverage: Layer-dependent; many products are regional or overview-level
sources.currentness: Per-layer product date and method; capture both.

licence.name: Product-specific public geodata terms
licence.note: Retain each layer's product sheet and limitations.

limitations: SGI states that many layers are suited to overview planning and require their product sheets and specialist interpretation.

sources.name: Översvämningsportalen
sources.coverage: Mapped rivers, coasts and identified flood-risk areas; scenario availability varies
sources.currentness: Per flood study and report; scenario year and climate adjustment must be retained.

licence.name: Public geodata terms
licence.note: Capture the individual study terms and report.

limitations: Layer and scenario coverage varies between studies.
Absence from a mapped flood extent does not establish zero flood or stormwater risk.

sources.name: Naturvårdsregistret services
sources.coverage: Sweden, national protected-area register with noted layer-specific update gaps
sources.currentness: Record decision status, legal-force state and retrieval date.

licence.name: Open data
licence.note: Attribution or third-party producer rights may apply.

limitations: Protected-area geometry must be joined to the governing decision and status.
Species and local nature values need separate investigation.

sources.name: Natura 2000 services
sources.coverage: Swedish Natura 2000 sites
sources.currentness: Bind site record, decision/reference documents, status and retrieval date.

licence.name: Open data
licence.note: Attribution or third-party producer rights may apply.

limitations: Intersection or proximity requires site objectives, conservation documents and competent-authority review.
An empty intersection does not replace species or habitat investigation when risk is indicated.
resolution_requires: plot geometry and ecological context buffer

sources.name: Current shoreline-protection guidance
sources.coverage: Sweden under rules effective 2025-07-01
sources.currentness: Re-check current Environmental Code, county decisions and municipal records for every plot.

licence.name: Public legal guidance
licence.note: Cite Naturvårdsverket and current Environmental Code.

limitations: Distance to mapped water alone cannot determine shoreline-protection applicability.
County administrative board decisions can introduce or remove protection in specific cases.

sources.name: Fornsök and the cultural-environment register
sources.coverage: Known cultural remains and archaeological assignments in Sweden
sources.currentness: Bind register version and location-uncertainty attribute.

licence.name: Open data
licence.note: RAÄ publishes downloadable files and APIs as open data.

limitations: RAÄ warns that records can be outdated and mapped positions or extents can be inaccurate.
Ground work within or near a protected remain requires county administrative board consultation.

sources.name: EBH map — risk-classified potentially contaminated sites
sources.coverage: Known and suspected sites; public map contains limited information
sources.currentness: Bind EBH object ID, risk-class date and any requested detailed record.

licence.name: Public information
licence.note: Detailed EBH support extracts are request-based public records.

limitations: Presence indicates a potentially contaminating activity, not confirmed contamination.
Absence does not provide a complete national clean-land certificate; sampling is needed.

sources.name: County Administrative Boards geodata catalogue
sources.coverage: National and county-specific planning layers
sources.currentness: Per-layer metadata, extent and maintenance frequency.

licence.name: Dataset-specific open terms
licence.note: Retain producer, metadata and limitations for every selected layer.

limitations: Many layers are planning indicators or interpretations; controlling decisions and municipal plans must be read.

sources.name: NVDB road data
sources.coverage: Swedish road network; open API offers selected current NVDB products
sources.currentness: Current data by API product; bind retrieval and product version.

licence.name: Trafikverket open-data terms
licence.note: Reading is open; account registration is required to retrieve API data.

limitations: Road proximity and road-manager attributes do not establish a servitude or permitted connection.

sources.name: Ledningskollen
sources.authority: Post- och telestyrelsen with Svenska kraftnät and Trafikverket
sources.coverage: Participating line owners responding to a user-created area case
sources.currentness: Per case, provider response and intended work period.

licence.name: Ledningskollen account and case terms
licence.note: The service is free but requires an account and case; provider terms can vary.

limitations: Ledningskollen does not store exact line maps; responses come from participating owners.
Only a line-location case intended for ground work authorises use for digging.

sources.name: Electricity-grid development plans and reliability data
sources.coverage: Swedish distribution-grid development plans and reported areas
sources.currentness: Plan period and reporting date; current 2026 map aggregates operator plans.

licence.name: Public statistics and open data terms
licence.note: Retain reporting period and operator source.

limitations: Network plans are strategic context; only the network operator can confirm a plot connection.

sources.name: SMHI open meteorological observations and analyses
sources.coverage: Sweden through stations and gridded products
sources.currentness: Per observation, station, analysis grid and API version.

licence.name: SMHI open-data terms
licence.note: Attribute SMHI where possible.

limitations: Nearest-station or gridded values require a documented interpolation method.
Building-code design values must come from the applicable current regulation, not raw weather observations.

sources.name: Municipal VA, stormwater, waste and building-committee response
sources.authority: Relevant Swedish municipality or municipal utility
sources.coverage: Identified property in one municipality
sources.currentness: Dated property-specific response and validity period.

licence.note: Municipality-specific public-record and response terms.

limitations: General web maps and fee schedules do not establish service availability or capacity at the plot.

sources.name: Property-specific utility connection and capacity responses
sources.authority: Relevant electricity, fibre, water, wastewater and district-energy providers
sources.coverage: Identified property and stated demand
sources.currentness: Per provider response, demand assumption and expiry date.

licence.note: Provider-specific confidential/commercial terms may apply.

limitations: Capacity must be tied to the exact demand, connection point, cost, lead time and validity period.

sources.name: Property-specific topographic and boundary survey
sources.authority: Qualified survey provider and, where required, Lantmäteriet cadastral procedure
sources.coverage: Commissioned plot and stated survey scope
sources.currentness: Survey date, equipment, control, CRS, vertical datum and responsible surveyor.

licence.note: Commission and reuse terms must permit project use.

limitations: If the legal boundary is disputed or uncertain, only the appropriate cadastral procedure can settle it.

sources.name: Geotechnical, groundwater, radon and environmental field pack
sources.coverage: Commissioned investigation locations and stated scope
sources.currentness: Investigation dates, standards, sampling plan, lab and responsible specialists.

licence.note: Commission and reliance terms must cover the project and design team.

limitations: The report must state investigation limitations and design parameters; screening maps cannot substitute for it.

gate_catalog.title: Exact property identity
close_requires: municipality and full property designation resolved to one property
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: An address, listing pin or coordinate is a locator only and cannot become the property identity.

gate_catalog.title: Municipality and county jurisdiction
close_requires: official municipality and county identifiers for the resolved property
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: Nearby address text cannot select the planning authority without a resolved property location.

gate_catalog.title: Indicative property-division geometry
close_requires: source CRS, release, hash and property identity
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: The register-map polygon remains indicative and cannot be relabelled as surveyed or legally binding.

gate_catalog.title: Current property-register standard extract
close_requires: dated extract for the exact property designation
owner, mortgage, tax, joint-facility and association fields recorded without omission
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: A map feature or seller document cannot replace the requested official extract.

gate_catalog.title: Rights, servitudes and joint facilities
close_requires: full relevant register records and cadastral acts
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: The standard extract is not the full register and silence cannot be interpreted as absence of rights.

gate_catalog.title: Boundary and topography suitable for design
close_requires: field survey tied to property records
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: National vector and height products are not a design survey or legal boundary determination.

gate_catalog.title: Governing detailed plan or outside-plan status
close_requires: complete current municipal plan map and provisions or official outside-plan confirmation
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: NGP can omit older plans and can include plans without legal force; portal absence is not outside-plan proof.

gate_catalog.title: Current national permit-law profile
close_requires: effective date and assessment date recorded
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: Pre-December-2025 Attefall summaries cannot control a current assessment.

gate_catalog.title: HouseKit H30/H50 plot-specific eligibility
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: A 30 m2 or 50 m2 footprint is not automatically permit-exempt and cannot itself close this gate.

gate_catalog.title: Defensible buildable envelope
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: No AI massing, setback buffer or permit-exempt-house rule may be drawn as an authoritative envelope.

gate_catalog.title: Reproducible national terrain context
close_requires: exact 1 m height-model item and raw hash
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: The terrain gate closes context terrain only; it does not close field topography or drainage design.

gate_catalog.title: Ground, groundwater, radon and contamination design basis
close_requires: contamination and infiltration testing where indicated
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: National geology, nearby wells and EBH screening cannot replace a plot-specific investigation.

gate_catalog.title: Flood, landslide, erosion and stormwater risk
close_requires: specialist study where screening indicates risk
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: Absence from a national mapped extent cannot be stated as no flood, slide, erosion or cloudburst risk.

gate_catalog.title: Protected nature, shoreline and water restrictions
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: A water-distance buffer or empty national overlay cannot prove permission or absence of protected species.

gate_catalog.title: Cultural heritage and contaminated-land risk
close_requires: field archaeology or sampling if triggered
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: Register absence cannot establish no unknown remains or no contamination.

gate_catalog.title: Legal and physically feasible access
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: A road touching or approaching the property polygon cannot prove a legal or permitted access point.

gate_catalog.title: Utility routes, connection capacity, cost and lead time
close_requires: connection points, costs and lead times
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: Ledningskollen line responses and strategic network plans cannot prove spare connection capacity.

gate_catalog.title: Pre-construction line and authority clearance
close_requires: current Ledningskollen line-location case for the work area
gate_catalog.false_positive_guard: A design-stage utility map or old case cannot authorise digging or construction.

Use Mesan2gv3 for new meteorological-analysis adapters and regression-test grid and parameter changes before Mesan2gv2 is withdrawn.
